rows.note: This is the all-purpose genetics term for a trait or allele that can be masked by a dominant one.

example.english: This genetic trait is recessive and usually appears only when both parents have it.
example.traditional: 呢個遺傳特徵係隱性，通常要父母雙方都有先會表現出嚟。
